common.title: Frontier Access Denied
common.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

common.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
common.line: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier.

common.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
common.line: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion.

notable.title: Anti ai municipal revolt
notable.line: Municipal utilities and clinic networks stage coordinated switch-off protests against forced AI upgrades after the ransomware sweep, blocking two data-centre expansions and delaying continuity-stock refresh for months.

notable.title: Grid connection blockade
notable.line: Coordinated municipal protests block data-centre grid connections in several member states, forcing temporary construction halts and emergency power renegotiations.
